Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create forty active parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all forty and no other part.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; click Download Template, open the file in a spreadsheet program, add 40 rows, one per part, with part_number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425768-001 to ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425768-040, name ZZAUTOTEST PL C425768 PART and the same number, quantity 1 and purchase_price 10, and save it as a CSV file. Click Select CSV File, pick the file, then click Submit File.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
